## Updates:
- GP#1843: Added support for selecting a Java runtime once by long-pressing the run jar file button (by @CiiLu)
- GP#1867: Added a real-time JVM installation log card to the task flow dialog (by @MovTery)

## Changes:
- GP#1868: Updated default control layout (by @MovTery)
- GP#1869: In control layout, newly created joystick controls now default to Ctrl as the lock event modifier (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- GP#1864: Force game JVM to use UTF-8 encoding, fixing FTB mods failing to initialize properly (by @MovTery)
- GP#1865: Installer failing to start in foreground service when GlobalContext is not initialized (by @MovTery)
- GP#1871: Fixed corner radius distribution issue for file manager entries (by @MovTery)
- GP#1874: GLFW bridge initialization now uses the calling thread's JNIEnv, fixing crashes and freezes caused by cross-thread reuse (by @MovTery)

bodies.markdown:
## 更新：
- GP#1843：支持长按运行 jar 文件按钮时单次选择 Java 运行时 (by @CiiLu)
- GP#1867：任务流对话框新增安装 JVM 实时日志卡片 (by @MovTery)


## 调整：
- GP#1868：更新默认控制布局 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1869：控制布局中，新创建的摇杆控件的锁定事件默认添加 Ctrl (by @MovTery)


## 修复：
- GP#1864：强制游戏 JVM 使用 UTF-8 编码，修复 FTB 系模组无法正常初始化 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1865：未初始化 GlobalContext 安装器在前台服务中启动失败 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1871：修复文件管理器条目的圆角分配问题 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1874：GLFW 桥初始化改用调用线程 JNIEnv，修复跨线程复用导致的崩溃与卡死 (by @MovTery)
